name: Mortis Engine
text: Nexus of Death Energy: When a friendly Deathrattle or Deadwalkers unit wholly within 12" of this unit is picked to be the target of the 'Deathly Invocation' ability, add D3 to the number of damage points that can be healed or the combined Health characteristic of models that can be returned. name: Killaboss on Great Gnashtoof (Scourge of Ghyran)
text: Drag 'Em Out: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Declare: Pick an enemy Infantry Hero in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll 2D6. name: Prosecutors
text: Dispersed Formation: This unit has a coherency range of 2". Heralds of Righteousness: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3. Weapon abilities: Charge (+1 Damage).

name: Praetors
text: Soul-bonded: Timing: Deployment Phase Pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Hero to be this unit's soul-bonded charge for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Soul-forged Guardians: While this unit's soul-bonded charge is within this unit's combat range, both this unit and that soul-bonded charge have Ward (5+).

name: Saurus Astrolith Bearer
text: Celestial Conduit: Timing: Reaction: You declared a Spell ability for a friendly Seraphon Wizard wholly within 12" of this unit If that spell is successfully cast, for the rest of the turn, add 3 to the control scores of friendly Seraphon units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. Revivifying Energies: Friendly Seraphon Infantry units have Ward (6+) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. If a unit already has Ward (6+), it has Ward (5+) instead.

name: Gutseers
text: Arcane Contortions: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for visible enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit. Add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly Mawseekers Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. This unit is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as 'Unbind'.

name: Fane of Slaanesh
text: Damned Conduit: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn while the target is within x" of this terrain feature, the target's weapons have the Companion weapon ability, where X is determined by the current battle round as follows: Battle Round 1: 9" Battle Round 2: 12" Battle Round 3: 15" Battle Round 4: 18" Battle Round 5: 21"

name: Long-Range Support
text: Timing: Your Shooting Phase Declare: Pick an objective within 15" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and that no friendly units are contesting. Each unit contesting that objective is a target. Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

name: Willing Sacrifice
text: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks while there are no other friendly units within its combat range.

name: Oath of Restoration
text: Timing: Your Hero Phase Declare: Pick a friendly Duardin Ascendant Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible objective within 18" of them that is coned by 2 or more friendly unified units to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. If the chanting roll was 7+, friendly Duardin Ascendant models have Ward (5+) while they have any models contesting the target instead. Keywords: Prayer

name: Freeguild Grenadiers
text: Cinders and Ashes: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Declare: If this unit contains a Cindergout, pick a terrain feature or objective contested by this unit, then pick any enemy units contesting that terrain feature or objective to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

text: Aethermatic Anatomiser: Timing: Your Shooting Phase Declare: If this unit's Bjorgen Thundrik is on the battlefield, pick an objective within 12" of this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+: • If the target is controlled by either player, that player loses control of that objective. • The target cannot be contested until the start of your next turn. name: Incensed
text: Timing: Your Hero Phase Declare: Pick an objective within 6" of this unit to be the target. Until the start of your next turn, friendly Hedonites of Slaanesh units are not visible to enemy units more than 9" from them while all models in those friendly units are contesting the target objective.

text: Form a Wall: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more friendly units are wholly outside friendly territory, wholly within 6" of friendly territory and within 3" of each other. name: Exalted Hero of Chaos
text: Glory-seeker: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for attacks that target Heroes or Monsters. Weapon abilities: Anti-Hero (+1 Rend), Anti-Monster (+1 Rend).

name: Powerful Presence
text: Timing: End of Any Turn Declare: Pick this Hero to use this ability if it is contesting an objective that you do not control. Add D3 to this Hero's control score this turn.

name: Legend of the Parch
text: Daring Rescue: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if an enemy unit that was in combat at the start of the turn was destroyed by a combat attack made by a friendly unit that charged this turn. Command from the Front: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 2 or more friendly Heroes on the battlefield, all friendly Heroes are within 9" of a visible enemy unit and no friendly Heroes were slain this turn. text: Soulreaper: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. After this ability has been resolved, you gain a number of relentless discipline points equal to the number of total damage points allocated by this ability this turn. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the enemy unit being rolled for. Weapon abilities: Anti-Monster (+1 Rend), Anti-War Machine (+1 Rend).

name: Chained by Obligation

text: Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Corpse-beast's Talons is 5. name: Crypt Horrors
text: Holy Blades of Bone: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll 2 dice for each model in this unit. Add 2 to each roll if the target is Cavalry. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Weapon abilities: Anti-Cavalry (+1 Rend), Crit (Auto-wound).

name: Reikenor the Grimhailer
text: Corpse Candles: Timing: Any Hero Phase Declare: Pick either this unit or a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. If you picked this unit, allocate 1 damage point to this unit and add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point). If you picked an enemy unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit and for the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. • Add 1 to this unit's power level. Grim Justice: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made with this unit's Fellreaper if the target is a Priest or a Wizard. Wraithstorm: Timing: Your Hero Phase Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models are slain as a result of this ability, inflict a further D3 mortal damage on the target Keywords: Spell Weapon abilities: Charge (+1 Damage), Companion, Crit (Auto-wound).

name: Deafen Them with Fire!
text: Timing: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase Declare: If this unit is under orders, pick a pinned enemy unit that was the target of all this unit's shooting attacks this turn to be the target. Until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent declares a command for the target, unless they spend 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

name: Malevolent Maelstrom
text: Morbid Detonation: Timing: End of Any Turn Declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 maelstrom points. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets. Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed. Necrotic Vortex: Give this Manifestation 1 maelstrom point each time: • This Manifestation is set up. • A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation. • A model is slain within 12" of this Manifestation. This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 maelstrom points at once. Weapon abilities: Crit (2 Hits).

name: Rage of Arkhar
text: Timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Your CombatPhase Declare: If you have 1 or more oath points, pick a friendly Snow Peaks unit that has not used an Oath ability this turn to be the target. Spend 2 oath points. The target can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn. Keywords: Oath

name: Darkfire Daemonrift
text: Fuelled by Sorcery: Each time a spell is successfully cast by a unit within 12" of this Manifestation, give this Manifestation 1 ruinous energy point, to a maximum of 6. Each time this Manifestation uses a Shoot ability, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its Darkfire Torrent for each ruinous energy point it has. If this Manifestation is removed from play, all of its ruinous energy points are lost. Weapon abilities: Shoot in Combat.

text: Timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. Friendly Fyreslayers units have Ward (5+) for the rest of the battle round. Keywords: Ur-gold Rune

text: High Priest of the Zharrgrim: Each time a Prayer chanted by this unit is answered, this unit gains a magmic power token. If you do so, apply the effect below that corresponds to the Ur-gold Rune ability that was used: *Rune of Fury:* For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Fyreslayers units while they have Strike-first. *Rune of Fiery Determination:* Add 1 to save rolls for friendly Fyreslayers units for the rest of the battle round. *Rune of Relentless Zeal:* Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly Fyreslayers units for the rest of the battle round. *Rune of Searing Heat:* Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Fyreslayers units for the rest of the battle round. *Rune of Farsight:* Increase the range of the 'Rune of Farsight' ability to 16".

name: Rune of Searing Heat
text: Timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. Melee weapons used by friendly Fyreslayers units have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the battle round. Keywords: Ur-gold Rune

name: Ghyranite Mount
text: Non-Hero Infantry only. Add the Ghyranite Mount's Teeth, Hooves, or Claws weapon to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. Then, make the following changes to your Regiment Hero's warscroll: • Change the Move characteristic to 12". • Change the Health characteristic to 3 or add 1 to the Health characteristic. • Change the Save characteristic to 4+. • Replace the Infantry keyword with the Cavalry keyword.

name: Rune of Fury
text: Timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, friendly Fyreslayers units have Strike-first while they are in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn. Keywords: Ur-gold Rune

text: Disposable Lackeys: Timing: Deployment Phase This unit can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

text: Fill the Pot: This unit's cauldron is either filled with grisly remains or empty. It starts the battle empty. If an enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn is destroyed and this unit's cauldron is empty, it becomes filled with grisly remains. This unit's cauldron is now empty. Pick 1 of the following effects: *Bloodgruel:* The target has Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn. *Spinemarrow:* Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

name: Swift Skirmishers
text: Timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round Declare: You gain 1 swift point for each unit in this Regiment of Ghyran that is on the battlefield. Divide those swift points among those units in any combination. Then, pick each friendly unit that has any swift points to be the targets. Make a swift move for each target by rolling a number of D3 equal to the number of swift points it has. The target can move a number of inches equal to the swift move roll. It cannot move through or end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units. After this ability has been resolved, your swift points are reset to 0 (any that have not been used are lost).

name: Cruising Into Position
text: Timing: Deployment Phase Declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown that have not been deployed. Set up all of those units in reserve plying the winds. They have now been deployed. Keywords: Deploy

name: Poisoned Domain
text: Timing: Once Per Turn, End of Your Turn Declare: Pick all units (friendly and enemy) within 1" of any terrain features to be the targets. Roll a dice for each target. On a 1, inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

text: Timing: Deployment Phase Declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown if none of them have been deployed. Set up those units in reserve prowlin' around*. They have now been deployed. Keywords: Deploy

name: Calm and Collected
text: Timing: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn Reduce your and your opponent's fury levels by up to 3, to a minimum of 0. You must reduce both players' fury levels by the same amount.

text: Each player can use one of the following Honour Guard abilities in each battle. When using that ability, they must pick a unit in their general's regiment to be the honour guard.

Weapon abilities: Anti-Infantry (+1 Rend), Companion, Shoot In Combat.

name: Immolation of the Realms
text: Timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round Declare: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round if there are Wyrdpyres on the battlefield. Resolve the effect below that corresponds to the number of Wyrdpyres on the battlefield. 1-2: Inflict 1 mortal damage on each unit within 3" of any Wyrdpyres. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly units that were allocated any of that damage for the rest of the battle round. 3-4: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit within 3" of any Wyrdpyres. Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that were allocated any of that damage for the rest of the battle round. 5-6: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit within 6" of any Wyrdpyres. Models that cannot be set up in this manner are slain, Then, remove that terrain feature from the battlefield.

name: Wrathmongers
text: Bloodfury: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 3" of this unit to be the target. Both player's roll off. If you win the roll-off, pick a melee weapon that the target is armed with. Your opponent must pick a visible unit in their army within 3" of the target (they can pick the target's own unit, and even if it is a single-model unit). Your opponent must resolve combat attacks for the target using the melee weapon you picked against the unit they picked. Crimson Haze: While this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Bloodbound units, excluding Wrathmongers units, while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. Weapon abilities: Blood-hungry, Crit (2 Hits).

name: Battered Shrimp
text: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Declare: Pick an enemy non-Monster Hero in combat with this unit to be the target. Both players roll off. If you win the roll-off, roll off again. Keep rolling off in this way until you lose the roll-off. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of roll-offs made as part of this ability that you won this turn. Keywords: Rampage

Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Loosely Attached Bladed Limbs for the rest of the phase for each target picked. Add 1 to hit rolls for the targets' attacks for the rest of the phase, including those made with Companion weapons. Keywords: Rampage Regenerating Terror: Timing: End of Any Turn Heal (D6) this unit. name: Sequitors
text: Sequitor Aetheric Channelling: Timing: Any Combat Phase If this unit is contesting an objective you control, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn: • Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target this unit have no effect. • This unit's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+. Weapon abilities: Crit (2 Hits).

name: Blades of Eternal Rust
text: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase Declare: Pick an enemy unit that is in combat with any friendly Nighthaunt units to be the target. Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

name: Argy Bargy
text: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase Declare: Pick any number of friendly Big or Little units to be the targets. Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise. • Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3.
